checksums.name: global_header_checksum
checksums.formula_detail: 16 little-endian u32 words (64-byte record). Before summing, word[0]:=0 and word[1]:=0xFFFFFFFF (placeholders). checksum = sum(word[0..15]) mod 2^32 = (sum(word[2..15]) - 1) mod 2^32. Stored word[0]=checksum, word[1]=bitwise NOT of checksum (one's complement).

checksums.name: global_header_checksum_mirror
checksums.formula_detail: Identical formula and stored-field layout as global_header_checksum, applied to the mirrored record at absolute offset 0x6D40.

checksums.name: slot_select_label_leading_field
checksums.formula_detail: u16 at 0x6d80 (0x001e in cap-01) followed by u32 at 0x6d82 (0x61299ed6 in cap-01). Brute-force tested against sum8/sum16/sum32/xor8/xor32/crc32 (standard and inverted) over every plausible byte range in the file; no algorithmic match found.

checksums.name: zerosave_footer_trailing_fields
checksums.formula_detail: u32 at 0x7f78 (0x000042c0 in cap-01) and u32 at 0x7f7c (0x3bf20802 in cap-01). Same brute-force search as slot_select_label_leading_field; no match found.

open_questions: Writer function(s) for the 0x6D80-0x6DA6 slot-select-label block and the 0x7F70-0x7F7F ZEROSAVE footer block were not located among the 339 decompiled functions provided.
No checksum/sum/xor/CRC32 algorithm (over any tested byte range) matches the numeric fields at 0x6D82 and 0x7F78/0x7F7C; their true derivation is unknown.

Absolute SRAM offsets of the three 0x1220-byte game-save slots and their redundant copy regions are code-confirmed but could not be located in either provided .sav sample, since neither sample has a populated game-save slot.
The third header-redundancy candidate referenced by FUN_08075c7c(param_1==2) was not found at a distinct SRAM offset in either sample; it may be RAM-only or simply unexercised.

Semantics of the single copied byte/u16 header fields at offsets +0x0C, +0x0E, +0x11, +0x12, +0x13, +0x14, +0x18 are code-confirmed as copies from an external source struct, but all read as zero in both available samples.

PACKET.md's corpus metadata references 6 total captured .sav files and richer active-range data than the 2 files actually provided to this workspace; the slot-rotation/selection behavior across the full corpus is unverified here.
